annotations.title: SEC 8-K event feed by item (cyber incidents, auditor changes, exec departures...)

description: SEC 8-K event feed by item (cyber incidents, auditor changes, exec departures...) — Recent SEC 8-K filings that report a given item, across all public companies or one company. item= 8-K item number (1.05 cyber incident, 4.01 auditor change, 4.02 restatement, 5.02 officer/director change, 1.03 bankruptcy, 3.01 delisting notice, 2.06 impairment, 2.05 layoffs/restructuring, 2.01 acquisition, 2.02 earnings...) or a keyword (cyber, auditor, restatement, executive, bankruptcy, delisting, impairment, layoffs, acquisition, earnings, control, dilution, vote). Optional: days= (1-365, default 30), ticker= or cik= to restrict to one company, limit= (1-100, default 25). Returns company, tickers, filed date, all items in the filing with names, red flags, filing URL and index URL, repeat filers and counts by day. For item 1.05 also lists voluntary Item 8.01 cybersecurity-incident disclosures. Source: SEC EDGAR full-text search (public domain). Price: $0.005 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: sec_8k_events
